E-moose-atv-0061.recDirections: From 100 Mile House, head west onto Exeter Station road and follow this road through the industrial part of town, cross the railway tracks and keep left. Continue on this road to the end of the pavement, and then continue on the gravel 1100 Road for about 20 km and turn left onto the 1000 Road (Gustafsen South FSR). From here, travel about 12 km to the 10-32 km marker and turn left/east onto the access road. Travel for approximately 1 km to the recreation site. The access road is fairly rough, so four wheel drive is recommended. The site is not suitable for large trailers or motorhomes.
